fuente.titulo: Pope in Peru: ‘Distance does not necessarily diminish love for one’s homeland’

titular: Pope Leo urges Peru's leaders to protect peace
bajada: In his first Peru address, he spoke of his own roots and everyday peace for citizens
caption: In his first public address in Peru, delivered to civil authorities and the diplomatic corps, Pope Leo XIV spoke of his long-held personal ties to the country and urged leaders to safeguard the “everyday peace” of ordinary Peruvians. Source: Vatican News, Nov 12, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: A formal government reception hall in Lima with national flags, a lectern in the upper right third, left and center areas left open and uncluttered
